# FreshnessStamp

Says how current the data on screen is: an absolute Melbourne stamp, a relative age, a warning once it goes stale, and an "Updating…" state that keeps the old…

`SongNodes.FreshnessStamp` · Status

## Use

```jsx
<SongNodes.FreshnessStamp label="…" at={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SongNodes.FreshnessStamp" label="…" at="{{…}}"></x-import>
```

## Props (FreshnessStampProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `label` * | `string` | Lead-in naming the data ("Library as of"). |
| `at` * | `string \| null` | Data time as ISO; null when never loaded. |
| `staleAfterDays` | `number` | Days after which the stamp warns (default 8, weekly data). |
| `refreshing` | `boolean` | A refresh is running; the old stamp stays. |
| `short` | `boolean` | Short relative form for headers and card footers. |
